# Time Lapse Network

> > A curated showcase of exceptional timelapse and hyperlapse cinematography from around the world, featuring work by acclaimed filmmakers using Canon, Dynamic Perception, and eMotimo equipment.

Time Lapse Network highlights stunning visual storytelling through time-based photography, covering destinations from Norway's Lofoten Islands to Chicago's urban landscapes. The site features technical breakdowns of equipment like Canon 5D Mark II, LRTimelapse workflows, and motion control systems, while celebrating both astrophotography and travel cinematography.

## Key Topics

- Timelapse & Hyperlapse Cinematography
- Canon Equipment (5D Mark II, 7D, 24mm f/1.4L II, 70-200mm f/2.8L II)
- LRTimelapse Workflow
- Motion Control Systems (Dynamic Perception Stage Zero, eMotimo TB3)
- Astrophotography & Night Sky Photography
- Travel & Landscape Photography
- Aurora Borealis & Milky Way Imaging
- Notable Locations: Norway, Lofoten Islands, Spain, France, Mont Blanc
- Featured Filmmaker: Kirill Neiezhmakov
- Camera Lenses: Samyang 14mm f/2.8 IF ED UMC
- Winter & Seasonal Timelapses
- Urban & Architectural Hyperlapse
- Multi-Country Travel Projects

## Epic Urban Hyperlapse Projects

- [Chicago at 200,000 shots and 2TB of data, can you believe it?!](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/chicago-at-200000-shots-and-2tb-of-data-can-you-believe-it): Max Wilson's epic 200,000-shot Chicago timelapse project with Canon 5D
- [480GB of data for a hyperlapse of 5' on Barcelona](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/480gb-of-data-for-a-hyperlapse-of-5-on-barcelona): Alexandr Kravtsov's 24,000-photo Barcelona hyperlapse with Canon 7D
- [Paris 2013 timelapse in motion: one of the best hyperlapse 2013](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/paris-2013-timelapse-motion-uno-dei-migliori-hyperlapse-del-2013): Kirill Neiezhmakov's acclaimed Paris hyperlapse from 2013
- [4 minutes of dizziness around Toronto](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/4-minutes-of-dizziness-around-toronto): Tom Ryaboi's 'Rising City' aerial timelapse of Toronto from heights
- [Ford celebrating its 111th anniversary with a 24-hour hyperlapse!](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/ford-celebrating-111th-anniversary-24hour-hyperlapse): Ford's 111th anniversary 24-hour hyperlapse by Mattia Bicchi & team

## Astrophotography & Night Sky

- [The King of the night goes into the atmosphere](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/the-king-of-the-night-goes-into-the-atmosphere): Michael Shainblum's 'Into The Atmosphere' California night sky tribute
- [Home at the Shore: over 5,000 photos under the stars of USA](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/home-shore-5000-photos-stars-usa): Jack Fusco's 5,000-photo Milky Way timelapse of New Jersey beaches
- [10 Days to Norway to see the Light](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/10-days-to-norway-to-see-the-light): Matt Murnaghan's northern lights timelapse from Tromso, Norway

## European Landscapes & Travel

- [Watch how amazing Lofoten islands can be in winter in one of the best videos of 2015](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/watch-amazing-lofoten-islands-winter-videos-2015): Tommaso Maiocchi's winter timelapse of Norway's Lofoten Islands
- [Get ready to watch something terrific, from Austria!](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/ready-watch-terrific-austria): Geoff Tompkinson's hyperzoom timelapse through Hallstatt, Austria
- [4 days on the road discovering the Colours of Europa](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/4-days-road-discovering-colours-europa): Daniel Santos' panoramic road trip timelapse through Picos, Spain
- [Take a wild ride around Rijeka, Croatia](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/take-wild-ride-rijeka-croatia): Hyperlapse tour of Rijeka's waterways and Adriatic coastline in Croatia
- [The Alsace in a French time-lapse of impact](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/the-alsace-in-a-french-time-lapse-of-impact): Collaborative timelapse of France's Alsace region by three photographers
- [When spring blooms in the Valtellina, the world turns](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/when-spring-blooms-in-the-valtellina-the-world-turns): Antonio Selva's HDR spring timelapse of Italy's Valtellina region

## Global Travel Showcases

- [Travel to New Zealand, the land of the Long White Cloud](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/travel-zealand-land-long-white-cloud): Stephen Patience's Aotearoa timelapse showcasing New Zealand landscapes
- [Simply .. because I love them! Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Iceland ..](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/simply-because-i-love-them-australia-new-zealand-canada-iceland): Multi-country travel timelapse across Australia, NZ, Canada & Iceland
- [Here's the reason of visiting Asheville during fall](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/heres-the-reason-of-visiting-asheville-during-fall): Fall foliage timelapse showcasing Asheville, North Carolina's beauty

## Corporate & Creative Projects

- [Hotel Radisson in Sochi gets beautifully timelapsed](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/hotel-radisson-sochi-gorgeous-corporate-timelapse): Kirill Neiezhmakov's corporate hyperlapse for Hotel Radisson Sochi
- [Atom Lapse: where the other photographers do not enter!](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/atom-lapse-where-the-other-photographers-do-not-enter): Richard Bentley's interior hyperlapse of Brussels' Atomium monument
- ["Time", a music video in time lapse](https://timelapsenetwork.com/video/time-a-music-video-in-time-lapse): Izabo's Eurovision music video combining timelapse & stop motion
